evidence.title: Freebuff Plans: Free and paid plans

name: Freebuff
summary: Free AI coding agent: CLI, desktop app, web app builder, cloud sandboxes and chat, funded by in-CLI text ads.
description: Five free products from the Codebuff team: a CLI coding agent installed with npm, a full-stack web app builder that hosts and deploys what it builds, cloud sandboxes for GitHub repos, a chat assistant and a desktop app that runs agents in parallel workspaces. Free daily usage credits are funded by text ads; paid plans add more model time, and enterprise/self-hosted deployment is offered at no cost.
contains: five free products: CLI, Web app builder, Cloud sandboxes, Chat, Desktop app
CLI installs with npm install -g freebuff; runs on macOS, Windows and Linux
funded by text ads in the CLI; no subscription or credit card required
free daily credits by country (e.g. US 100/day, DE/FR/ES 40, elsewhere 25)
model picker includes GLM 5.3 Flash, DeepSeek V4.1 Flash, GPT-5.6 Luna, MiMo 2.5
Freebuff Web builds, hosts and deploys full-stack apps from a prompt
desktop app runs multiple agents in parallel workspaces
